note: The violations the deterministic checker cannot decide, and what each would need instead. The checker's own output is the authority for which items these are: harness/deterministic_check.py prints them under 'cannot be judged in code'. This file only classifies them, and check_claims.py fails if the set here stops matching the checker's output. Written after the manuscript stated 'ten items' where the checker reports nine.

classes.language_model: requires reading a statement and judging what it covers or whether it is owed
classes.document_parser: a layout property of the typeset document, recoverable without a model
classes.external_lookup: an authority file settles it; no reasoning involved
classes.structural: a section-placement rule, decidable once the document is segmented

items.reason: requires identifying which author is the corresponding one before asking whether an ORCID iD is given for them
judging an address incomplete requires knowing which components a postal address is expected to carry
the bioRxiv deposition statement is present but in the Introduction rather than the prescribed section
vertical rules between table columns are a property of the typeset table
the position of the table title relative to the table body is a layout property
footnote markers numbered rather than lettered is a layout property
the Index Medicus abbreviation of a journal title is settled by Crossref and the NLM Catalog
requires noticing that rabbit skeletal muscle implies an animal ethics statement is owed
requires comparing the authors a consent statement names against the author list
